name: state_residence_id
description: Código FIPS da unidade federativa de residência do falecido; ausente no arquivo público a partir de 2005
description_en: FIPS code of the decedent's state of residence; absent from the public-use file from 2005 onward
description_es: Código FIPS del estado de residencia del fallecido; ausente del archivo público a partir de 2005
observations: state FIPS; native FIPS 1982-2002, NCHS alphabetical code mapped 1968-1981, postal code mapped 2003-2004; ABSENT from the public-use file 2005 onward

name: county_residence_id
description: Código FIPS do condado de residência do falecido, disponível apenas de 1982 a 2004
description_en: FIPS code of the decedent's county of residence, available only from 1982 to 2004
description_es: Código FIPS del condado de residencia del fallecido, disponible solo de 1982 a 2004
observations: 5-digit state+county FIPS, 1982-2002 only. Deliberately NOT back-filled from the pre-1982 `countyrs`, which is an NCHS county code on a different numbering system

name: residence_status

name: age_detail_code

description_en: Raw age code with its unit prefix, as published by NCHS
description_es: Código bruto de edad con prefijo de unidad, tal como lo publica NCHS
observations: raw unit-prefixed age code as published; 3 characters before 2003, 4 from 2003

name: age_years
description: Idade do falecido em anos completos, derivada de age_detail_code; nula quando a unidade não é anos ou a idade é desconhecida
description_en: Age of the decedent in completed years, derived from age_detail_code; null when the unit is not years or age is unknown
description_es: Edad del fallecido en años cumplidos, derivada de age_detail_code; nula cuando la unidad no es años o la edad es desconocida
observations: derived from age_detail_code; NULL when the record's age unit is not years or age is unknown

description: Indicador de que a raça foi convertida pela metodologia ponte

description_es: Indicador de que la raza fue convertida por la metodología puente
observations: 2003 onward

name: race_recode_6
description: Raça do falecido em seis categorias de raça única sob o padrão OMB de 1997, a partir de 2022
description_en: Race of the decedent in six single-race categories under the 1997 OMB standard, from 2022 onward
description_es: Raza del fallecido en seis categorías de raza única bajo el estándar OMB de 1997, desde 2022
observations: single race under the 1997 OMB standard, 2022 onward. Replaces the bridged race_recode_3/5, which NCHS stopped publishing after 2020

name: race_recode_40
description: Raça detalhada do falecido em 40 categorias de raça única sob o padrão OMB de 1997, a partir de 2019; de 2021 em diante é a única informação de raça no arquivo
description_en: Detailed race of the decedent in 40 single-race categories under the 1997 OMB standard, from 2019 onward; from 2021 it is the only race information in the file
description_es: Raza detallada del fallecido en 40 categorías de raza única bajo el estándar OMB de 1997, desde 2019; desde 2021 es la única información de raza en el archivo
observations: detailed single race under the 1997 OMB standard, 2019 onward. From 2021 this and race_recode_6 are the only race information in the file: the bridged race_code is no longer populated

name: hispanic_origin_code
description: Origem hispânica do falecido
description_en: Hispanic origin of the decedent
description_es: Origen hispano del fallecido
observations: 1989 onward

name: hispanic_origin_race_recode
description: Origem hispânica e raça ponte combinadas sob o padrão OMB de 1977, de 1989 a 2020
description_en: Combined Hispanic origin and bridged race under the 1977 OMB standard, 1989 to 2020
description_es: Origen hispano y raza puente combinados bajo el estándar OMB de 1977, de 1989 a 2020
observations: Hispanic origin by BRIDGED race (1977 OMB standards), 1989-2020. Width 1 separates it from the 1997-standard recode below; NCHS states the two are not comparable, and 2021 is not populated in the source

name: hispanic_origin_race_recode_1997
description: Origem hispânica e raça única combinadas sob o padrão OMB de 1997, a partir de 2022; não comparável à versão anterior
description_en: Combined Hispanic origin and single race under the 1997 OMB standard, from 2022 onward; not comparable to the earlier version
description_es: Origen hispano y raza única combinados bajo el estándar OMB de 1997, desde 2022; no comparable con la versión anterior
observations: Hispanic origin by SINGLE race (1997 OMB standards), 2022 onward. NOT comparable to hispanic_origin_race_recode

description_es: Años de escolaridad completados según el certificado de 1989; no comparable con education_code
observations: 1989 certificate: YEARS of schooling completed. Width 2 disambiguates it from the 2003-revision `educ`. NOT comparable to education_code

observations: 2003 certificate: CATEGORIES. NOT comparable to education_years
